property_summary: Only the depositorAccount (the public getter) can successfully call setL1BlockValues; any caller other than that address must cause the call to revert, and if call reverts then C's observable public getters remain unchanged from before the call.
If setL1BlockValues call succeeds (does not revert) then depositorAccount remains unchanged and at least one of the public L1 block fields equals the corresponding argument passed in the call.
